summary: Standardize account-derived service access with Digital Twin readback

delivery.outcome: A provider-neutral wellmanifest.service-access/v1 standard that composes verified parent-account evidence, Vault metadata, reviewed connector operations, exact-plan authority and versioned Digital Twin readback.
nonGoals: Read, copy or expose credential values
Create a provider tenant or primary provider account
Execute a connector operation from the standard repository
Redefine authentication, authority or Twin lifecycle ownership
Make Plesk or Subactor a runtime dependency of the standard

architecture.decision: Extend account-runtime with a separately versioned declarative service-access catalog rather than altering immutable account-runtime/v1 or duplicating twin-lifecycle. The catalog is evidence-only and fail-closed; runtime owners map its opaque operation references to real connectors.
dataChanges: Standardize provider-child account provisioning and Digital Twin readback without credential values
architecture.rollback: Remove the four ticket-owned material files or their service-access additions; immutable account-runtime/v1 remains unchanged.
